model: Full pinned FAFB v783 LIF network; connectome weights fixed
learned_parameters: Small explicit cue-choice readout/adapter only; no biological synaptic-learning claim
cue_populations: Two distinct sensory populations must be validated and pinned before training; not invented from game labels
positions: Balanced left/right assignment independently randomized by trial seed
observations: Cue presence/location and neural readout only; no reward identity, phase, correct choice, target location or seed exposed to policy
updates: Reward supplied only after completed choice; adapter updates only during training; frozen during held-out evaluation
baselines: fixed cue-A heuristic with no reversal rule
metrics: held-out choice accuracy by phase and seed
success: Predeclare paired held-out trained-minus-random and trained-minus-learning-disabled accuracy differences by training seed. Require at least 0.10 improvement and a positive 95% bootstrap interval (10,000 resamples, seed 303, training seed as resampling unit) before claiming improvement. Report all per-seed results; four training seeds limit statistical confidence. Fixed cue-A heuristic never receives a reversal rule.
execution_gate: atomic neural/world/RNG checkpoint restoration across restart
